description: NaSrCrF₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.87 Å. Sr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.67 Å. Cr is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.92-1.97 Å. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sr, and one Cr atom to form distorted edge-sharing FNa₂SrCr trigonal pyramids. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Sr and one Cr atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, and one Cr atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, and one Cr atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sr and one Cr atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Cr atom.
